capabilities: Title pasted URLs as Markdown links
Link selected text by pasting a URL over it
Fetch titles through the Web viewer session for listed domains
Run commands to title URLs at the cursor or in a selection
Import Bilibili cookies into the Web viewer session
disambiguation: Not a session or tab manager; it titles pasted URLs and only uses a browser session as a fallback for fetching titles.
extras: Alpha release; the browser fallback relies on an undocumented internal Web viewer interface that a future Obsidian update may break. Optional Bilibili cookie import handles account credentials, is limited to bilibili.com, and cannot guarantee that site challenges pass.
intentEvidence: Disable other automatic title plugins, including Named Links and the earlier Link Title Browser Fallback
motivation: The author's two motivating cases were a Zhihu article and a Bilibili video whose titles ordinary fetching could not retrieve.
problem: Pasted URLs stay as bare addresses because some sites reject ordinary HTTP requests, so their titles cannot be fetched.

relations.evidence: Disable other automatic title plugins, including Named Links and the earlier Link Title Browser Fallback
No dependency on Named Links, Auto Link Title, or the earlier local fallback helper

summary: Desktop plugin that converts pasted URLs into titled Markdown links, falling back to Obsidian's Web viewer session for sites that block plain requests.
